resources.string: Locke uses this to notice when you open an app, or browse to a website, you\'ve chosen to block, so it can show your habit checklist until you\'ve completed today\'s habits (or keep it blocked outright, for lists you\'ve set to never unlock).
Do your habits.\nThen use your apps.

Right now, the apps that pull at your attention are one tap away, any time, for no reason at all. Locke changes the terms: it locks them down, and hands the key back only once you\'ve done what you actually meant to do today.
Set the locks and cut the keys yourself -- about a minute, start to finish
Take habits on the honor system, or require a photo an AI checks, so there\'s nothing to fake
Streaks, a daily lootbox, and a bedtime curfew carry the discipline past today

Name the apps you lose hours to, and they\'ll stay locked until today\'s habits are done. Nothing locks until setup is finished, and this list is never final -- add or remove apps anytime from Settings.
No apps selected yet -- that\'s fine, you can lock some later from Settings.
Every habit you pick here is a key to the locks you just set. Check at least one to continue -- you can edit, add, or remove habits anytime later.

Miss one of these today, and the apps it guards stay locked -- that\'s the deal. Want a habit that\'s just tracked, or an antihabit, or one a photo has to prove? Add those later from Settings; these five are just a running start.
Only #1 gates your apps right away. Each one after it takes over once the habit before it is a consistent streak, so the full weight of Hard Mode never lands on day one.

Everything so far has been on paper. These three permissions are what let Locke actually see a blocked app open and put the lock screen in front of it. All are optional right now -- skip any and finish setup anyway, then grant them later from Settings. Until they\'re granted, nothing you set up above actually locks anything.

Photo verification (add an Anthropic API key in Settings), a hard bedtime curfew, antihabits you pay a time penalty for slipping on, and the daily lootbox that hands out grace tokens and skip tokens -- all live in Settings, ready whenever you want them.
Lets Locke see which app is currently open, so it knows when to show the lock screen.
Lets Locke detect the moment you switch into a blocked app.
Lets Locke show the lock screen on top of a blocked app.
Reminds you about unfinished habits and streak milestones.
Finish these habits to unlock it for the rest of today.
Finish these habits to unlock this site for the rest of today.
Blocked by your \"%1$s\" list -- no habit or grace token unlocks it.

Today\'s habits are already done -- this one\'s still locked for now.
Use a grace token (%1$d left) -- 1 min unlock
Lock the apps you pick below -- everything else stays open.
Lock every app except the ones you pick below -- those stay always open.
